[EN] Stay sharp and stay calm. You panic or get mad and you're as good as dead. Simple as that.

Be patient and make your first strike count.
[ES] Mantente alerta y conserva la calma. Si entras en pánico o te enojas, estás prácticamente muerto. Así de simple.

Ten paciencia y haz que tu primer golpe cuente.
